name: Listening app
summary: A made-up podcast player on a phone: a library with the episode to carry on with as the one card, followed shows as drawn covers on a rail, and the latest episodes with a play button each; one episode with its chapters; a now-playing screen that rises from a mini player above the tab bar and drags down to close, its cover stepping back while paused, a scrubber notched at each chapter, skip back and forward, speed and a sleep timer; and Up next, reordered by drag or by keyboard. From 768px a sidebar, and the episode beside the library. Onboarding, loading, empty and error states.
anatomy: Welcome (drawing, one sentence, Find shows to follow) → Library: large title, Carry on (cover, title, time left, play, progress), shows you follow as a rail of covers, latest episodes with play → Episode: cover, number and date, title, Play from 19:05, queue and download, about, chapters → Now playing (rises from the mini player): close, cover, title and chapter, scrubber with chapter notches, back 15, play, forward 30, speed, sleep, chapters → Up next: reorder by drag or keyboard → Settings: grouped settings. The mini player rides above the tab bar on every screen.
type: editorial: a reading face for titles that are sentences, set large on the player
motion: An app moves only to answer the person: a pushed screen slides in from the trailing edge, a tab cross-fades, the player rises from the mini player and drags down to close, and its cover steps back a little while paused.
